name: VectorTile
description: Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT/PBF) layer rendered with L.vectorGrid on the map, with optional 3D building extrusion on the globe.

supportedData.label: Mapbox Vector Tiles (MVT / PBF)
supportedData.description: Templated protobuf vector tiles addressed by z/x/y. Per-sublayer styling via style.vtLayer; feature identify via style.vtId/vtKey. PostGIS geodatasets can be served as MVT through the internal API.
supportedData.procurement: Generate MVT with tippecanoe or serve from a vector-tile server; upload vectors as a geodataset for API-served MVT.

supportedData.label: Extrudable building tiles (3D)
supportedData.description: MVT tiles carrying a height property (e.g. OSM buildings) extruded into 3D polygons on the globe. Configure extrudeHeightProperty/extrudeColor/etc.
supportedData.procurement: MVT tiles that include a per-feature height attribute.

supportedData.label: GeoDataset-served vector tiles
supportedData.description: A PostGIS geodataset (uploaded via 'Manage Geodatasets') served as MVT vector tiles through the internal API.
supportedData.procurement: Upload vectors in Configure → Manage Geodatasets, then reference via geodatasets:{name}.
